label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 242 ]

blocks.text: Sunlight looks white, but it is actually a mixture of all the colors of the rainbow. Each color travels as a wave, and blue light has a shorter wavelength than red light. When sunlight enters the air, it hits tiny gas molecules. These molecules scatter short blue waves much more strongly than long red waves. As a result, blue light is spread across the whole sky, and it reaches our eyes from every direction. At sunset, sunlight passes through much more air before it reaches us, so most of the blue is scattered away and the sky looks red and orange.

readingSentences.korean: 각 색은 파동으로 이동하는데, 파란빛은 빨간빛보다 파장이 짧다.

readingSentences.english: When sunlight enters the air, it hits tiny gas molecules.

readingSentences.english: These molecules scatter short blue waves much more strongly than long red waves.
readingSentences.korean: 이 분자들은 짧은 파란 파동을 긴 빨간 파동보다 훨씬 강하게 흩뜨린다.

readingSentences.english: As a result, blue light is spread across the whole sky, and it reaches our eyes from every direction.
readingSentences.korean: 그 결과 파란빛이 하늘 전체에 퍼져 모든 방향에서 우리 눈에 들어온다.

readingSentences.english: At sunset, sunlight passes through much more air before it reaches us, so most of the blue is scattered away and the sky looks red and orange.
readingSentences.korean: 해 질 녘에는 햇빛이 우리에게 닿기 전에 훨씬 더 많은 공기를 지나기 때문에 파란빛은 대부분 흩어져 버리고 하늘은 붉은색과 주황색으로 보인다.
